name: codesplash-agent
description: Terminal cockpit for Codex and Claude Code — your AI accounts, one terminal, credentials stay on your machine.

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.release:current: bun run check && git tag -a "v$npm_package_version" -m "CodeSplash Agent v$npm_package_version" && git push --atomic origin HEAD "refs/tags/v$npm_package_version"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin HEAD && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin HEAD && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin HEAD && git push origin --tags
